parents.course: Sem in Wrks of Select Composer

ns2:section.sectionText: This course will study in depth the music of composer Libby Larsen (b. 1950), especially her vocal works, symphonies, and operas, as well as her musical influences. Assignments will include presentations and weekly response papers based on listening, score study, and scholarly readings, including a newly published biography of Larsen by Denise Von Glahn (http://www.press.uillinois.edu/books/catalog/77gyt4ge9780252041150.html). Additionally, students will complete a significant, original research paper as part of the coursework.
